evals.prompt: Audit this React component for accessibility: used as the main navigation toggle. No other attributes are present.
evals.expected_output: Identifies missing alt text on image, missing aria-label on button, missing keyboard focus indicators, and lack of semantic HTML.
assertions: Flags the missing alt attribute on the img element
Recommends adding aria-label or aria-labelledby to the button
Notes the need for visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation

evals.prompt: Our React dashboard re-renders 47 components when a single student score updates. The page freezes for 800ms on each update. Diagnose and fix.
evals.expected_output: Identifies unnecessary re-renders, suggests React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, state colocation, and component splitting strategies.
assertions: Identifies the cascading re-render problem from state propagation
Recommends React.memo or useMemo to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Suggests state colocation or context splitting to limit render scope

evals.prompt: Our LCP is 4.2 seconds, FID is 350ms, and CLS is 0.35 on the student dashboard page. All Core Web Vitals are failing. Propose optimization strategies.
evals.expected_output: Addresses each metric: lazy loading and image optimization for LCP, code splitting and defer for FID, dimension attributes and skeleton screens for CLS.
assertions: Proposes specific strategies to reduce LCP below 2.5 seconds
Recommends code splitting or deferred loading to improve FID below 100ms
Suggests layout stability techniques like explicit dimensions or skeleton screens for CLS

evals.prompt: We want to implement a micro-frontend architecture. Our app has 4 major sections: student portal, teacher dashboard, admin panel, and analytics. All currently share a single React build.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates Module Federation vs single-spa, proposes decomposition strategy, addresses shared state and routing, considers build and deployment independence.
assertions: Evaluates at least two micro-frontend approaches (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa)
Proposes clear boundaries for the 4 sections as independent micro-frontends
Addresses shared state management and cross-micro-frontend communication

evals.prompt: Review this Material-UI usage pattern: we are importing the entire @mui/material package with import { Button, TextField, Grid } from '@mui/material' in 50+ components. Is this a problem?
evals.expected_output: Identifies tree-shaking issues with barrel imports, recommends deep imports or modular plugin, quantifies bundle size impact.
assertions: Identifies that barrel imports can hinder tree-shaking and increase bundle size
Recommends deep path imports like '@mui/material/Button' as an alternative
Quantifies or estimates the bundle size impact of the current approach
